quickAnswer: Survive twelve trials by repeating a deliberate Shop → Place → Equip → Battle → Plan rhythm. Three battles without a win end the journey.

sections.title: Start with the road
paragraphs: Draft a leader and a defining trait, then build a company one market at a time. Training leads into Fair, Unfair, and eventually Ranked.
bullets: Read unit trait, skills, and tactic together
Place for range and adjacency before committing
Use each result to plan the next shop

sections.title: Read a unit card
paragraphs: Vitals show HP, ES, and MP. Attributes show STR, AGI, and INT. Combat values show attack, critical chance, range, speed, armor, and evasion. Gear slots, traits, skills, and tactics explain how that baseline changes.
bullets: A high number without a usable position may be wasted
Rolled traits can change a familiar recruit
Primary attributes can lead toward Ascendancy

sections.title: Avoid early mistakes
paragraphs: Do not buy an item before confirming its requirement and available slot. Do not treat Backline, Formation, and Flanking as cosmetic tags. Do not assume an old build remains current through Early Access patches.
bullets: Check open hand or trinket slots

quickAnswer: Place for tactic, range, adjacency, and the enemy line. Good placement makes verified skills connect before auto-battle takes control.

sections.title: Formation, Backline, and Flanking
paragraphs: The current public cards use three tactic labels. Formation units stay in line and can reduce damage, Backline units prefer the rear, and Flanking units can enter behind enemies.
bullets: Goodly Knight and Portly Knight — Formation
Skeleton Child and Skeleton Dog — Flanking

sections.title: Build around adjacency
paragraphs: Goodly Knight adds STR to adjacent allies. Skeleton Child can pass half of hand-gear benefits to adjacent allies. Move either unit and the value map changes.
bullets: Do not leave support touching an irrelevant target

sections.title: Inspect the opposing line
paragraphs: Range, formation, flanking, adjacency, and opposing-line shape are all named by the official game description as meaningful. Use the available inspection view before locking placement.

quickAnswer: Use vitals to judge resources, attributes to judge scaling, and combat values to judge battlefield behavior. Then read trait, skill, tactic, and gear together.

sections.title: Vitals
paragraphs: HP determines when a unit falls. ES absorbs damage first and regenerates. MP powers spell tomes.

sections.title: Attributes
paragraphs: STR, AGI, and INT feed different families of derived stats, while a primary attribute may also feed attack and Ascendancy progression.

sections.title: Combat values
paragraphs: ATK is damage before armor, CRT is double-damage chance, RNG is attack distance, SPD is action and movement speed, AR reduces damage, and EVA can avoid a hit before armor or energy shield applies.

quickAnswer: Spend only after checking requirements, slots, and the next placement. In multiplayer, remember that the shop is shared and contested purchases become live bids.

sections.title: Single-player shopping
paragraphs: The road cycles through shopping, placement, equipment, combat, and planning. A purchase has value only if the company can equip it and the formation can use it.
bullets: Compare immediate power with future scaling
Keep enough flexibility for the next market

sections.title: Income effects
paragraphs: Some public items and traits add income. Feather Charm of Reflex and Ruby Charm of Wit list income bonuses, while Portly Knight's Hoarding trait rewards several equipment types being on the board.
bullets: Income text is part of the item or trait effect
Requirements can delay the purchase's practical value
Do not turn an income example into a universal economy rule

sections.title: Multiplayer bidding
paragraphs: In a tournament, 2–8 players share markets. Contested items open at list price; players raise or pass. Mixed-faction lobbies can also put units up for bid.

quickAnswer: Raise a primary attribute far enough to Ascend once, then choose a Power, Fortitude, or Authority outcome that fits the unit's real board job.

sections.title: Three paths
paragraphs: Power converts attributes toward attack, Fortitude converts them toward defense and recovery, and Authority converts them toward resource or tempo values.
bullets: Fortitude — armor, evasion, ES, or recovery
Authority — HP, speed, MP, and regeneration

sections.title: Verified examples
paragraphs: The public units guide shows Crushing, Elusive, Revelatory, and Momentous as four example Ascendancies.
bullets: Revelatory — can spend extra MP to restore a spell cooldown
Momentous — repeated attacks on one target gain ATK

sections.title: Avoid automatic recommendations
paragraphs: An Ascendancy label alone does not prove the best choice. Position, gear, target access, mode, and current patch all affect the recommendation.

quickAnswer: A Goodly Trials multiplayer tournament seats 2–8 human or AI companies, shares markets, resolves live bids, locks formations, and tracks a season table.

sections.title: Set up the tournament
paragraphs: The host seats humans and AI and chooses how often every pair meets. That choice determines the shape of the season before the first bid.
bullets: Humans and AI can share the table

sections.title: Bid in the shared market
paragraphs: Players act one decision at a time. Contested items start at list price, and rivals either raise or pass. Mixed-faction lobbies can also auction units.
bullets: Plan a maximum price before bidding
Remember that denial also costs resources
Keep formation needs ahead of collection instinct

sections.title: Lock, fight, and read standings
paragraphs: Companies prepare independently, then fight across a turn-based league. Standings continue through the season until one champion remains.

quickAnswer: Finish Training, Fair, and Unfair progression before Ranked. Rating begins at Soldier: 200 and moves with each completed journey.

sections.title: Unlocking Ranked
paragraphs: The official route is Training → Fair → Unfair → Ranked. Fair adds bosses and Deed spending, while Unfair unlocks Old Man and later leader traits.

sections.title: Rating thresholds
paragraphs: The official modes guide names eight ladder thresholds.

sections.title: Treat the ladder as versioned
paragraphs: Early Access balance can change unit, trait, item, and evaluation behavior. A Ranked guide should always display its game version and separate official thresholds from player strategy.
